answer_1.quote: We propose debatable query-focused summarization (DQFS)... creates a multi-aspect summary, with each paragraph covering one of an input number of topics... MODS is a multi-LLM system using a Mixture of Document Speakers...
answer_1.outputs: Balanced, multi-aspect summaries with citations for each paragraph

answer_2.quote: We compute DC (document coverage), fairness (KL divergence to uniform), faithfulness (KL divergence to input stance distribution)... We also use Prometheus to score interest, coherence, relevance, coverage, diversity and Self‑BLEU for paragraph diversity.
automatic_metrics: Prometheus quality scores (interest, coherence, relevance, coverage, diversity)

answer_3.quote: We use Prometheus, an LLM with 72‑85% human agreement, for 1‑5 scoring of summaries... We also assess citation accuracy via an entailment LLM.
methods: LLM evaluation with rubric scoring prompt

answer_4.quote: We recruited 76 participants via Prolific... each participant rated summaries on Readability and Balance using Likert scales...
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated summaries on two Likert items: Readability (clarity, grammar, flow) and Balance (extent to which both sides of the debatable query are covered).
